Kentucky Site 5 Shawnee

By mrogers August 8, 2025

Shawnee

One of the last 4 remaining active Fossil plants. I'm glad to get a chance to visit them before they are all gone. At one time it was considered the 3rd largest coal power plant in the world.

It's history is only eclipsed by the sheer size of the stacks.

As the day was soon ending it was time to say goodbye to a brief stay at Shawnee.. Here you go! More on Shawnee!
